subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) Then the leader of the robbers came to Saddi and ordered him to give all he had to him. (b) The merchants had their goods and a lot of money but Saddi had a bundle of books and some money with him. (c) The robbers took away all the goods and money from the merchants. (d) They travelled for twelve days without trouble. (e) Saadi then asked, "I hope that you will make good use of these books." (f) On the thirteenth day a gang of robbers attacked them. (g) Sheikh Saadi handed him the bundle of books and also the money he had with him. (h) Once Sheikh Saddi was going to Baghdad with a group of rich merchants.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
